integrity_note: Finite computation corroborates algebra; analytical proofs supply all-limit conclusions. Priority is best-knowledge and has not been independently verified.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the original ideal true-moment oracle step on two equally likely scalar quadratic losses with exact arithmetic and 0<x0<1. It proves inverse-moment lower growth, not matching upper bounds, and does not analyze estimated/safeguarded practical implementations.
title: Exponential inverse-stepsize moments amid vanishing loss for a stochastic oracle rule
